purpose: Readiness matrix for source-evidence review across superconductivity benchmark and theory branches.

readiness_rows.name: Raw McMillan benchmark package
readiness_rows.blocking_reason: The raw gate is runnable, but row-level provenance normalization is still incomplete and the benchmark remains FAIL.

readiness_rows.name: Allen-Dynes or comprehensive parameter package
readiness_rows.blocking_reason: The comprehensive package exists, but it is still a topic-local package without source-backed row normalization and held-out validation.

readiness_rows.name: Conventional-row normalization evidence package
readiness_rows.blocking_reason: The row-evidence workflow is in place, but the remaining Vanadium and A15 source checks are still pending.

readiness_rows.name: High-Tc and hydride benchmark package
readiness_rows.blocking_reason: High-Tc and hydride branches are present in data files but are not yet part of a primary gated benchmark package.

readiness_rows.name: UET coherence or relativistic correction package
readiness_rows.blocking_reason: The correction terms remain heuristic and do not yet have a held-out validation artifact.

claim_boundary: A ready row has enough provenance structure for source review. It does not itself upgrade a claim.
